summary_en: 60,000 shares, ¥82.44M limit, 0.6% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). ToSTNeT-3 block execution at ¥1,374 closing price on 2026-08-07 08:45 JST. Results to be published same day post-trade.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares via off-exchange purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Boutiques, Inc. filed notice on 2026-08-06 of a single-day block buyback to be executed on 2026-08-07. The company will place a purchase order via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange purchase transaction) at 08:45 JST on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, limited to 60,000 shares at a ceiling price equal to the day's closing price of ¥1,374 per share, for a total cost not to exceed ¥82.44 million. The order is valid for that trading window only. This block is part of a broader authorization resolved by the board on 2026-02-12 and expanded on 2026-06-16, permitting acquisition of up to 600,000 shares for up to ¥600 million through 2026-12-31 via either discretionary market purchase or ToSTNeT-3. As of 2026-08-06, the company has cumulatively acquired 145,900 shares for ¥218.38 million under this program. Results will be published immediately after the trade execution.
